paragraphs.source_en: Volley after volley of gunfire rang out around Shōnyū; he had already entered the heart of the battlefield. Suddenly, a bullet grazed past his ear and struck the trunk of a pine tree to his left.

units.source_en: Volley after volley of gunfire rang out around Shōnyū; he had already entered the heart of the battlefield.
units.source_zh: 一阵阵枪声不断在胜入周围响起，他已进入了战场的腹地。

units.source_en: Suddenly, a bullet grazed past his ear and struck the trunk of a pine tree to his left.
units.source_zh: 突然，一颗子弹擦过耳边，打在了他左边的松树干上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一阵阵枪声不断在胜入周围响起，他已进入了战场的腹地。突然，一颗子弹擦过耳边，打在了他左边的松树干上。

paragraphs.source_en: The sky was clear, while cries of battle rose incessantly all around him. Shōnyū knew perfectly well that most of them were illusions, but that alone showed how badly shaken he was. He could not help cursing his own cowardice.

units.source_en: The sky was clear, while cries of battle rose incessantly all around him.

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the course of the battle had changed completely.

units.source_en: By then, the course of the battle had changed completely.
units.source_zh: 此时，战争形势已完全改变了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，战争形势已完全改变了。

paragraphs.source_en: Emboldened by their crushing defeat of Hidetsugu, the high-spirited forces of Sakakibara and Ōsuga seized the opportunity to attack Hori Hidemasa, only to suffer a setback at Hinokine and find themselves on the verge of disorder. Ii Naomasa came to reinforce them on Ieyasu's orders. Leading three thousand picked troops equipped with six hundred arquebuses, Ii launched a fierce attack on Hidemasa, who had pursued them all the way.

units.source_en: Emboldened by their crushing defeat of Hidetsugu, the high-spirited forces of Sakakibara and Ōsuga seized the opportunity to attack Hori Hidemasa, only to suffer a setback at Hinokine and find themselves on the verge of disorder.
units.source_zh: 借着大破秀次的余威，士气高涨的神原和大须贺的两支人马又乘机向堀秀政发动了攻击，不料在桧根失手，眼看就要陷入混乱。

units.source_en: Ii Naomasa came to reinforce them on Ieyasu's orders.
units.source_zh: 井伊直政奉家康之命前来增援。

units.source_en: Leading three thousand picked troops equipped with six hundred arquebuses, Ii launched a fierce attack on Hidemasa, who had pursued them all the way.
units.source_zh: 井伊率领了三千精兵，配有六百支火枪，向一路追击而来的秀政发起了猛烈攻击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 借着大破秀次的余威，士气高涨的神原和大须贺的两支人马又乘机向堀秀政发动了攻击，不料在桧根失手，眼看就要陷入混乱。井伊直政奉家康之命前来增援。井伊率领了三千精兵，配有六百支火枪，向一路追击而来的秀政发起了猛烈攻击。

paragraphs.source_en: Before Hidemasa's men could secure their footing, they were caught completely off guard. Meanwhile, to redeem themselves and defend the honor of the warriors of Mikawa, the routed Sakakibara and Ōsuga troops turned back and fell upon the enemy like demons.

units.source_en: Before Hidemasa's men could secure their footing, they were caught completely off guard.
units.source_zh: 秀政的人马立足未稳，一时被打了个措手不及。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, to redeem themselves and defend the honor of the warriors of Mikawa, the routed Sakakibara and Ōsuga troops turned back and fell upon the enemy like demons.
units.source_zh: 而败走的神原和大须贺为了挽回面子，捍卫三河武士的名誉，又掉过头来，像恶鬼一样扑来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀政的人马立足未稳，一时被打了个措手不及。而败走的神原和大须贺为了挽回面子，捍卫三河武士的名誉，又掉过头来，像恶鬼一样扑来。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, no one was in a more wretched position than Miyoshi Hidetsugu. Not only was he unfamiliar with warfare, but as Hideyoshi's dearly favored nephew he needed looking after at every turn, creating endless trouble for everyone.

units.source_en: In truth, no one was in a more wretched position than Miyoshi Hidetsugu.
units.source_zh: 其实，最狼狈的要数三好秀次了。

units.source_en: Not only was he unfamiliar with warfare, but as Hideyoshi's dearly favored nephew he needed looking after at every turn, creating endless trouble for everyone.
units.source_zh: 他不仅不熟悉战争，而且是深受秀吉喜爱的外甥，时时处处需要照顾，更给大家增添了不尽的麻烦。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，最狼狈的要数三好秀次了。他不仅不熟悉战争，而且是深受秀吉喜爱的外甥，时时处处需要照顾，更给大家增添了不尽的麻烦。

paragraphs.source_en: If Hideyoshi had miscalculated, this was likely where his error lay. Shōnyū had been constrained by the matter from the outset, while Hori Hidemasa had also been unable to act freely because he was overly concerned with Hakusanbayashi. Had he resolutely abandoned Hidetsugu and joined Mori Nagayoshi in linking up with Ikeda's forces, they might still have been able to contend with the Tokugawa army. Yet when Hidemasa attempted to join Mori Nagayoshi, his troops could no longer withstand the enemy's fierce assault and collapsed into a rout in the blink of an eye.

units.source_en: If Hideyoshi had miscalculated, this was likely where his error lay.

units.source_en: Yet when Hidemasa attempted to join Mori Nagayoshi, his troops could no longer withstand the enemy's fierce assault and collapsed into a rout in the blink of an eye.

paragraphs.source_zh: 若说秀吉失算，恐就在于此了。胜入从一开始就被此事所限，堀秀政也由于过分关注白山林而施展不开。假如他果断地放弃秀次，携森长可与池田部会师，或许还能和德川的兵马抗衡。然而，当秀政要和森长可会合的时候，他的部队却已禁不住敌人的猛攻，眨眼间便溃不成军。

paragraphs.source_en: Hori's rout naturally placed an unbearable strain on Mori Nagayoshi, and this forced union instead caused the fighting strength of Mori's troops to plummet.

units.source_en: Hori's rout naturally placed an unbearable strain on Mori Nagayoshi, and this forced union instead caused the fighting strength of Mori's troops to plummet.
units.source_zh: 堀的溃败自然给森长可带来难以承受的压力，这种勉强的会合，反而使森长可的部队战斗力顿减。

paragraphs.source_zh: 堀的溃败自然给森长可带来难以承受的压力，这种勉强的会合，反而使森长可的部队战斗力顿减。

paragraphs.source_en: With that, everything fell into place according to Ieyasu's design. Ii Naomasa led the charge, relentlessly pursuing Hori Hidemasa while attacking Musashi-no-kami at the same time. Sakakibara Yasumasa and Ōsuga Yasutaka followed close behind and launched a second assault on the enemy. Mori Musashi-no-kami, his eyes already bloodshot from killing, naturally refused to retreat and fought back desperately with all his strength.

units.source_en: With that, everything fell into place according to Ieyasu's design.
units.source_zh: 这样一来，一切纳入家康的谋划了。

units.source_en: Ii Naomasa led the charge, relentlessly pursuing Hori Hidemasa while attacking Musashi-no-kami at the same time.
units.source_zh: 井伊直政一马当先，一面对堀秀政穷追猛打，一面向武藏守发动攻击。

units.source_en: Sakakibara Yasumasa and Ōsuga Yasutaka followed close behind and launched a second assault on the enemy.
units.source_zh: 神原康政和大须贺康高则紧随其后，对敌人进行第二轮攻击。

units.source_en: Mori Musashi-no-kami, his eyes already bloodshot from killing, naturally refused to retreat and fought back desperately with all his strength.
units.source_zh: 已经杀红了眼的森武藏守自然不肯后退，拼死进行顽强反击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样一来，一切纳入家康的谋划了。井伊直政一马当先，一面对堀秀政穷追猛打，一面向武藏守发动攻击。神原康政和大须贺康高则紧随其后，对敌人进行第二轮攻击。已经杀红了眼的森武藏守自然不肯后退，拼死进行顽强反击。

paragraphs.source_en: By then Ieyasu himself, leading the generals under his banner, had charged down Mount Fujine like a fierce tiger. Driving like a sharp blade between Ikeda's troops, who were hurrying from Mount Rokubō to the rescue, and Mori Musashi's force, he cleanly prevented the two armies from joining. In fact, the gunshots and battle cries Shōnyū had dimly heard earlier were no illusion, but the raging tempest stirred up as Ieyasu's mighty army swept down the mountain.

units.source_en: By then Ieyasu himself, leading the generals under his banner, had charged down Mount Fujine like a fierce tiger. units.source_zh: 此时，家康也已率领旗下众将，如猛虎般冲下富士根山，像一把尖刀插入了从六坊山上赶来救援的池田部和森武藏部之间，利落地阻止了两军的会师。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，家康也已率领旗下众将，如猛虎般冲下富士根山，像一把尖刀插入了从六坊山上赶来救援的池田部和森武藏部之间，利落地阻止了两军的会师。其实，胜入先前隐约听到的枪声和呐喊，并不是错觉，而是家康雄师下山时掀起的惊涛骇浪。

paragraphs.source_en: The fourth band of routed soldiers Shōnyū encountered on the road numbered only four. By the time they collapsed exhausted before his horse, Kii-no-kami Motosuke and his second son, Sanzayemon Terumasa, had long since vanished from his side. It seemed the hand-to-hand fighting that had driven everyone into a frenzy had swallowed them as well.

units.source_en: The fourth band of routed soldiers Shōnyū encountered on the road numbered only four. By the time they collapsed exhausted before his horse, Kii-no-kami Motosuke and his second son, Sanzayemon Terumasa, had long since vanished from his side.

units.source_en: It seemed the hand-to-hand fighting that had driven everyone into a frenzy had swallowed them as well.

paragraphs.source_en: The four appeared to be a master and his retainers. The man who appeared to be their master was about twenty-two or twenty-three and did not seem to hold a particularly high rank. He had been shot and clutched his belly in agony. “We serve Lord Mori...” The young man stared blankly into space.

paragraphs.source_en: But the young man's head suddenly slumped. A retainer beside him, a man nearing fifty, hurriedly supported him, then turned to Shōnyū and said, “Lord Musashi-no-kami has fallen in battle.”

units.source_en: But the young man's head suddenly slumped. A retainer beside him, a man nearing fifty, hurriedly supported him, then turned to Shōnyū and said, “Lord Musashi-no-kami has fallen in battle.”

paragraphs.source_en: Shōnyū's vision went black. He knew the battle was lost, and a piercing pain suddenly shot through his ankle once more. At that moment, cries abruptly rose from a nearby hill. Mori Nagayoshi's entire army had collapsed, and Ieyasu's host was surging forward in overwhelming numbers; all that pressure now descended upon Shōnyū's shoulders.

paragraphs.source_en: What had to come had finally come! For a moment, the battle-hardened Ikeda Shōnyū seemed to see through everything. While his attendants hurried to carry the body of the guard who had just died into the grass, Shōnyū fixed his gaze on the soldiers charging heedlessly at the enemy.

units.source_en: What had to come had finally come!
units.source_zh: 该来的终于来了！

units.source_en: For a moment, the battle-hardened Ikeda Shōnyū seemed to see through everything.
units.source_zh: 久经沙场的池田胜入一时间似乎看破了一切。

units.source_en: While his attendants hurried to carry the body of the guard who had just died into the grass, Shōnyū fixed his gaze on the soldiers charging heedlessly at the enemy.
units.source_zh: 随从们忙着把刚死去的侍卫尸体抬进草丛，胜入则凝神注视奋不顾身杀向敌人的士兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 该来的终于来了！久经沙场的池田胜入一时间似乎看破了一切。随从们忙着把刚死去的侍卫尸体抬进草丛，胜入则凝神注视奋不顾身杀向敌人的士兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Every man was bent low, moving on tiptoe as though about to fall at any moment; however one looked at them, they appeared utterly wretched and fiercely agitated. If this continued, their strength would likely be spent in less than an hour. It was hardly surprising: soldiers who had won and then rested briefly were especially liable to succumb to nervous agitation.

units.source_en: Every man was bent low, moving on tiptoe as though about to fall at any moment; however one looked at them, they appeared utterly wretched and fiercely agitated.
units.source_zh: 只见大家都猫着腰，踮着脚，似马上就要倒下，怎么看都是极端狼狈、异常焦躁之状。

units.source_en: If this continued, their strength would likely be spent in less than an hour.
units.source_zh: 若照此下去，恐不到半个时辰，体力就会耗尽。

units.source_en: It was hardly surprising: soldiers who had won and then rested briefly were especially liable to succumb to nervous agitation.
units.source_zh: 其实也难怪，取胜之后又稍作休整的官兵，最易陷入焦虑不安。

paragraphs.source_zh: 只见大家都猫着腰，踮着脚，似马上就要倒下，怎么看都是极端狼狈、异常焦躁之状。若照此下去，恐不到半个时辰，体力就会耗尽。其实也难怪，取胜之后又稍作休整的官兵，最易陷入焦虑不安。

paragraphs.source_en: Soldiers attacking in such a state might recover their courage if they met an exceptionally weak foe who collapsed at the first touch. Otherwise, they would either expend every ounce of strength and fall exhausted or be consumed by agitation and march toward destruction.
